fusions.name: By the Collar
fusions.desc: A cut on a target up to 6 tiles away that deals 12 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach, and stuns it for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Clench, Then Draw
fusions.desc: A gripping cut that deals 4 damage, leaves the target [Leaden] for 2 seconds and leaves it 6% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Light Work
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

fusions.name: Binder's Glove
fusions.desc: Conjures a glove: your critical chance rises by 5%, your critical hits deal 0.15x more, each kill returns 3 health and your maximum health rises by 10.
